title: What happens if you quit psychology? With Fiona Maguire

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们不仅靠出卖时间换取金钱，还能赚取其他收入，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士（Dr Marianne Trent），自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和持续收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·福特（Sophie Foote）的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可规模化的产品，比如课程、会员制和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年自己完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的成长之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励，以及我独家提供的支持套餐，无需额外付费。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场团体内训、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特纳姆和梅森（Fortnum and Mason）的礼品，以及限时的一对一教练辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 欢迎通过简介中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你正打算成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 有这个播客伴你左右，你就在通往由玛丽安·特伦特博士主持的《有志心理学家》播客的路上。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有志心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent, and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Now, as you might well be aware, the road to becoming a qualified psychologist does not always run smoothly.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，通往合格心理学家的道路并不总是那么一帆风顺。

sentences.en: And of course, with the vast number of people who are wanting to join the profession and become qualified,
sentences.zh: 当然，由于想要加入这一行业并获得资格认证的人数庞大，

sentences.en: and the small amount of jobs available, it must mean that it doesn't work out for everybody.
sentences.zh: 而可用的工作岗位又很少，这意味着并非所有人都能如愿以偿。

sentences.en: And whilst that might be a painful consideration or a realisation to make, I thought it was a useful angle that we needed to cover within the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 虽然这可能是一个让人痛苦的考量或现实，但我认为这是我们在播客中需要探讨的一个有用的切入点。

sentences.en: So that is exactly what today's episode is going to be about.
sentences.zh: 所以，这正是今天这期节目的主题。

sentences.en: It's a guest interview episode with someone who started out on the route to professional psychology qualification,
sentences.zh: 这是一期嘉宾访谈节目，嘉宾最初走的是通往专业心理学资格认证的道路，

sentences.en: but then later had a different course and has had a different outcome.
sentences.zh: 但后来走了不同的方向，并有了不同的结果。

sentences.en: Now, this episode covers different bits and pieces that you might not use in your clinical practice or that you might not have heard of as well.
sentences.zh: 这期节目涵盖了你在临床实践中可能不会用到，或者你可能没听说过的一些零碎内容。

sentences.en: So listen with an open mind, and I will look forward to catching up with you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 因此，请以开放的心态收听，我期待在节目后半部分与你交流。

sentences.en: Hi, I would like to welcome Fiona Maguire to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎菲奥娜·马奎尔（Fiona Maguire）来到播客。

sentences.en: Fiona is a coach, a speaker and an author.
sentences.zh: 菲奥娜是一位教练、演讲者和作家。

sentences.en: Hi, Fiona.
sentences.zh: 嗨，菲奥娜。

sentences.en: Hi, Maureen.
sentences.zh: 嗨，莫琳。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm really well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 我很好，谢谢。

sentences.en: Really well.
sentences.zh: 非常好。

sentences.en: Enjoying a little bit of sunshine today, which is nice after all of the rain.
sentences.zh: 今天能享受一点阳光真好，经历了那么多雨天之后。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你怎么样？

sentences.en: Yeah, the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我也一样。

sentences.en: The sun has come out and it just lifts things up, doesn't it, really?
sentences.zh: 太阳出来了，整个人心情都舒畅了，对吧？

sentences.en: It's fantastic.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I know I'm like becoming an old hand here talking about LinkedIn, but we did meet on LinkedIn, didn't we?
sentences.zh: 我知道我在这里谈论领英（LinkedIn）快成老手了，不过我们确实是在领英上认识的，对吧？

sentences.en: We did.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢它了。

sentences.en: Do you love LinkedIn?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢领英吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 喜欢。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm getting to it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我越来越喜欢了。

sentences.en: I ignored it for years, but now, yeah, I'm really getting into it.
sentences.zh: 我忽略它好几年了，但现在，是的，我真的很喜欢它。

sentences.en: I love engaging with new people and finding out what they're doing and, you know, how we can work together, collaborate or help each other in any way.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢与新朋友互动，了解他们在做什么，以及我们如何以某种方式合作、协作或互相帮助。

sentences.en: It's fantastic.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And actually, I think it's a really good place to be if you are an aspiring psychologist, I think, anyway,
sentences.zh: 其实，如果你是一个有志成为心理学家的人，我觉得这也是个很不错的地方，

sentences.en: because you can connect with loads of people that are doing the job that you want to do.
sentences.zh: 因为你可以结识大量正在从事你想做的工作的人。

sentences.en: But you're not an aspiring psychologist anymore.
sentences.zh: 但你已经不再是一个有志心理学家了。

sentences.en: You are a coach, a speaker and an author.
sentences.zh: 你是一位教练、演讲者和作家。

sentences.en: Could you tell us a little bit about what you do currently, Fiona?
sentences.zh: 菲奥娜，能跟我们聊聊你目前的工作吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I'm an intuitive transformational coach.
sentences.zh: 我是一名直觉转化教练。

sentences.en: So I use all my psychological training, but I work on all levels of people.
sentences.zh: 我运用我所有的心理学训练，但在各个层面上与人们合作。

sentences.en: So my main superpower, if you like, is my intuition.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果可以这么说的话，我的主要超能力就是我的直觉。

sentences.en: And I've really honed my intuition so I can access people's unconscious mind.
sentences.zh: 我真正磨练了我的直觉，所以我可以进入人们的潜意识。

sentences.en: I can access what's going on inside of them.
sentences.zh: 我能够了解他们内心发生了什么。

sentences.en: And I ask them questions because if they own it, then, you know, that's when we can really do the work.
sentences.zh: 我向他们提问，因为如果他们自己领悟了，那才是我们真正能够开展工作的时候。

sentences.en: Whereas I say, oh, this is what I see.
sentences.zh: 而不是我说：“哦，这就是我看到的。”

sentences.en: They don't particularly own it and it doesn't have as much awe inspiring, you know, sort of a deep insight that they get inside of themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们并不特别认同，也没有那种能给他们内心带来深刻启迪的敬畏感。

sentences.en: So I work with their intuition.
sentences.zh: 所以我与他们的直觉合作。

sentences.en: I work with their unconscious mind, their energy, their conscious mind, their emotions, their thinking, all of them.
sentences.zh: 我与他们的潜意识、能量、显意识、情绪、思维——他们的整体合作。

sentences.en: And my aim is to obviously solve the problem they come to me for, but also for them to get a deeper understanding of who they really are.
sentences.zh: 我的目标显然是解决他们来找我时面临的问题，同时也让他们对真正的自己有更深的了解。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And obviously, a lot of our listeners might have spiritual or kind of holistic views and beliefs themselves.
sentences.zh: 显然，我们的很多听众自己也可能有精神上的或某种整体论的观点和信仰。

sentences.en: But when we try to put that into practice sort of in an NHS setting, that's difficult because of the evidence base.
sentences.zh: 但是当我们试图在NHS（国民保健制度）环境中付诸实践时，由于缺乏证据基础，这很困难。

sentences.en: Is there an evidence base for the way that you work?
sentences.zh: 你这种工作方式有证据支持吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, so I'm not, I'm not, people don't have to do anything spiritual with me.
sentences.zh: 对，我不强求，人们不需要跟我一起做任何精神层面的事情。

sentences.en: They don't have to go there if they don't want to.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不想的话，完全可以不涉足那个领域。

sentences.en: But what I actually do now is I talk about something that's called the three principles.
sentences.zh: 但我现在实际在做的是，我谈论一种叫做“三大原则”的东西。

sentences.en: And it was also coined the inside out perspective, which Michael Neal called it that.
sentences.zh: 它也被称为“由内而外的视角”，这是迈克尔·尼尔（Michael Neil）提出的。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of evidence for that.
sentences.zh: 这方面有很多证据。

sentences.en: And that's basically the psychological theory of perception, how perception really works and therefore how the mind really works.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是感知心理学理论，即感知是如何真正运作的，从而也是思维是如何真正运作的。

sentences.en: And then when you realize that you don't live in reality, you live in your own thought created reality, which is your own perception of everything.
sentences.zh: 然后当你意识到你不是生活在现实中，你生活在你自己的思想创造的现实中，也就是你对一切事物的自我感知中时。

sentences.en: And psychology agrees with that.
sentences.zh: 心理学是认同这一点的。

sentences.en: You know, wouldn't you agree that psychology agrees with that?
sentences.zh: 难道你不认为心理学是认同这一点的吗？

sentences.en: It's like a social construction, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这就像是一种社会建构，对吧？

sentences.en: And metacognitions and thoughts about thoughts about thoughts and all of that jazz.
sentences.zh: 还有元认知、对思维的思维的思维，以及所有这些酷炫的概念。

sentences.en: So I absolutely agree with that angle.
sentences.zh: 所以我绝对赞同这个角度。

sentences.en: Yeah, so as soon as people really, this has been my experience, my own personal experience and the experience of working with clients.
sentences.zh: 是的，一旦人们真正——这是我的经验，我个人的经验以及与客户合作的经验。

sentences.en: As soon as people realize that they're not their thinking and they don't have to be so identified with their thinking,
sentences.zh: 一旦人们意识到他们不是他们的思维，他们不必与他们的思维过度认同，

sentences.en: they then paradoxically start wondering and thinking, well, who am I and what am I?
sentences.zh: 他们就会自相矛盾地开始琢磨和思考：“那我究竟是谁？我是什么？”

sentences.en: And if I'm not experiencing the reality, then how do I experience the reality?
sentences.zh: “如果我体验到的不是现实，那我又是如何体验现实的呢？”

sentences.en: And when they really open up to that question, if I'm not experiencing the reality, does that explain why, you know,
sentences.zh: 当他们真正向这个问题敞开心扉时，“如果我体验到的不是现实，这是否能解释为什么，你知道的，

sentences.en: I sometimes have an argument with my spouse and it's like we're living in completely different worlds.
sentences.zh: 有时我和伴侣吵架，感觉就像我们生活在完全不同的世界里？”

sentences.en: I don't understand why he, she is so upset about something and, you know, they're thinking the same thing.
sentences.zh: “我不明白他/她为什么对某事如此心烦意乱”，而对方其实也在这么想。

sentences.en: And it's almost like we're talking from different universes.
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像我们在不同的宇宙中对话一样。

sentences.en: It's like that saying, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 就像那句老话说的，对吧？

sentences.en: There's three versions of an eventuality.
sentences.zh: 一件事情有三个版本。

sentences.en: There's your version, their version and the truth.
sentences.zh: 你的版本、他们的版本和真相。

sentences.en: And it's, yeah, it's what perception and what angle you're looking at that from.
sentences.zh: 这取决于你的感知以及你从什么角度来看待它。

sentences.en: And also, you know, what comes before and what trauma might have been around for one or both parties as to what might be a truly mindful reaction to what's going on now
sentences.zh: 还有，你知道的，什么走在前面，双方或其中一方可能存在什么创伤，从而对当下发生的事情做出真正正念的反应，

sentences.en: and what might have happened or be a ripple from things that have happened years ago.
sentences.zh: 以及可能发生了什么，或者是由多年前发生的事情所引发的涟漪效应。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全同意。

sentences.en: And also, you know, for me, when I first really got that, you know, actually, I'm just creating lots of stories in my head.
sentences.zh: 而且，对我来说，当我第一次真正领悟到这一点时——“实际上，我只是在脑海里编造了很多故事。”

sentences.en: That's the language I put on it.
sentences.zh: 这就是我给它的定义。

sentences.en: These are just stories.
sentences.zh: 这些都只是故事。

sentences.en: And yes, some of them to my brain seem valid because this happened in my paSt.
sentences.zh: 是的，其中有些对我的大脑来说似乎是合理的，因为这在我的过去发生过。

sentences.en: Of course, I'm going to act like this.
sentences.zh: 我当然会这样行事。

sentences.en: Of course, I'm going to act like that.
sentences.zh: 我当然会那样行事。

sentences.en: And then I was like, hold on, but am I really present?
sentences.zh: 然后我想：等等，但我真的活在当下吗？

sentences.en: Am I here?
sentences.zh: 我在这里吗？

sentences.en: Am I really present inside of myself, knowing what's going on inside of me?
sentences.zh: 我真的全然置身于自己的内心，了解自己内部正在发生什么吗？

sentences.en: And am I really present with the other person?
sentences.zh: 我真的全然陪伴另一个人了吗？

sentences.en: And if you're in your head too busy with your own story, then you can't be present.
sentences.zh: 如果你满脑子都是自己的故事，那你就不可能活在当下。

sentences.en: You can't really listen.
sentences.zh: 你无法真正倾听。

sentences.en: You can't really hear.
sentences.zh: 你无法真正听到。

sentences.en: And a lot of people are just too busy thinking about what they're going to say next to actually hear what the person said to them.
sentences.zh: 很多人满脑子都在想接下来要说的话，根本听不进去别人对他们说了什么。

sentences.en: I hear you.
sentences.zh: 我懂你的意思。

sentences.en: And that's a really important consideration for many of our audience as well who might be developing or striving for a career as a therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 这对我们的许多听众来说也是一个非常重要的考量，他们可能正在培养或争取成为一名治疗师的职业生涯。

sentences.en: Have you got any tips for ways that we can improve that ability to stay present and not be focused on, you know, is it the listening to hear rather than the listening to speak?
sentences.zh: 你有什么小建议可以帮助我们提高保持专注的能力，而不是专注于……是那种“为了倾听而倾听”而不是“为了说话而倾听”吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, one of the things that was said to me, and I've got one of my own, but one of the things that was said to me once, and it was part of a bigger course that I was on,
sentences.zh: 是的，有人曾对我说过这样一句话——我也有我自己的见解，但其中有一句话曾对我说过，它是我参加的一个更大课程的一部分，

sentences.en: and Michael Neal said it.
sentences.zh: 是迈克尔·尼尔说的。

sentences.en: He said, listen as if you're listening to music.
sentences.zh: 他说：倾听，就像你在听音乐一样。

sentences.en: And there was something in that that just dropped for me.
sentences.zh: 其中有些东西对我来说触动很深。

sentences.en: So maybe that doesn't drop for other people.
sentences.zh: 所以也许这对其他人未必有这种触动。

sentences.en: So my advice would be to centre yourself, to ground, to become into yourself and to know what's going on for you.
sentences.zh: 因此我的建议是：凝聚中心，脚踏实地，回归自我，清楚自己身上正在发生什么。

sentences.en: But to be centred in that, to not lost in your thinking or your emotions or your feelings, but to be centred.
sentences.zh: 但要立足于中心，不要迷失在你的思维、情绪或感觉中，而是要保持中心。

sentences.en: And to ground is one of the things I give away for free on my website, like House of Grounds.
sentences.zh: 脚踏实地（Grounding）是我在网站上免费提供的内容之一，比如House of Grounds。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And I guess I was thinking about what about the bits of music that really resonate with you and you want to join in or you want to sing and you want to stand up and dance?
sentences.zh: 我在想，那些真正与你产生共鸣、让你想加入其中、想唱歌、想站起来跳舞的音乐片段呢？

sentences.en: Are those the bits where you get the natural interaction that's kind of spontaneous rather than pre-thought?
sentences.zh: 那些是不是你获得自然互动的时刻？那种自发的而不是预先思考的互动？

sentences.en: That's really interesting.
sentences.zh: 这真的很有意思。

sentences.en: Isn't that amazing?
sentences.zh: 难道不是很奇妙吗？

sentences.en: You've seen it differently.
sentences.zh: 你的看法与众不同。

sentences.en: I love the way you've seen it, but you've seen it differently.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢你的视角，但你的视角确实不一样。

sentences.en: For me, it was like when I'm listening to music, I'm there.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，当我听音乐时，我就在那里。

sentences.en: I'm an open vessel.
sentences.zh: 我是一个开放的容器。

sentences.en: I'm just with it and I'm letting it flow through me.
sentences.zh: 我只是和它在一起，让它流淌过我的全身。

sentences.en: And then whatever may happen, you know, maybe a response to that.
sentences.zh: 然后无论发生什么，你知道的，也许是对它的回应。

sentences.en: So I love what you said.
sentences.zh: 所以我很喜欢你刚才说的话。

sentences.en: Maybe a response to that is that I want to dance or is that I want to join in or I just want to be with it or be closer to it.
sentences.zh: 也许对它的回应是我想跳舞，或者我想加入其中，或者我只是想和它在一起，或者离它更近一点。

sentences.en: So if you think of the music as a person, and I really love what you just said, then that's true connection, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 所以如果你把音乐想象成一个人——我真的很喜欢你刚才的话——那么这就是真正的连接，对吧？

sentences.en: That you want to be more with them.
sentences.zh: 你想和他们更多地在一起。

sentences.en: You want to dance with them.
sentences.zh: 你想和他们一起跳舞。

sentences.en: You want to hear more of what they've got to say or you just want to be in the flow of their company.
sentences.zh: 你想听更多他们要说的话，或者你只是想融入他们陪伴的氛围中。

sentences.en: That's beautiful connections.
sentences.zh: 这是美丽的连接。

sentences.en: Well, lovely.
sentences.zh: 太美妙了。

sentences.en: Although my husband, who is a musician, would say just listen to the music.
sentences.zh: 不过我丈夫是个音乐家，他会说：听音乐就行了。

sentences.en: Like they've done a good job, you know.
sentences.zh: 就像他们做得很好一样，你知道的。

sentences.en: There are many ways to look at the same consideration.
sentences.zh: 看待同一个问题有很多不同的方式。

sentences.en: And I understand that you originally were on a path to to psychology.
sentences.zh: 我了解到你最初走的是通往心理学道路。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: After my degree, I done the first single honours degree at the University of Luton.
sentences.zh: 我拿到学位后，在卢顿大学（University of Luton）读了第一个单一荣誉学位。

sentences.en: It's called now.
sentences.zh: 它现在被称为……

sentences.en: It's now called the University of Bedfordshire and looks a lot different.
sentences.zh: 它现在被称为贝德福德郡大学（University of Bedfordshire），看起来大不相同了。

sentences.en: I wanted to be a psychologist and my second job as an assistant psychologist, stroke group worker, was in what was called a psychiatric unit for adolescents.
sentences.zh: 我想成为一名心理学家，我的第二份工作是助理心理学家兼中风康复小组工作员，当时是在一个所谓的青少年精神科病房。

sentences.en: So that now called young people.
sentences.zh: 所以现在这被称为年轻人。

sentences.en: And that that was great.
sentences.zh: 而且当时感觉非常棒。

sentences.en: But my first thing that I noticed was, OK, so I know all these theories.
sentences.zh: 但我的第一点发现是，好吧，我知道所有这些理论。

sentences.en: I know what schizophrenia is and I want bulimia is and I want anorexia is.
sentences.zh: 我知道什么是精神分裂症，我知道什么是贪食症，我也知道什么是神经性厌食症。

sentences.en: Multiple personality disorder, as they called it then.
sentences.zh: 多重人格障碍，当时他们是这么叫的。

sentences.en: You know, I know all of these things now.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，现在我懂所有这些东西了。

sentences.en: Bipolar.
sentences.zh: 双相情感障碍。

sentences.en: But these kids like those three kids over there, they're all schizophrenic.
sentences.zh: 但这些孩子，就像那边那三个孩子一样，他们都有精神分裂症。

sentences.en: But they're all completely different.
sentences.zh: 但他们完全各不相同。

sentences.en: So how does the theory of psychology go with that?
sentences.zh: 那么心理学理论怎么能套用在这些情况上呢？

sentences.en: So I had questions right from the beginning and it was fascinating.
sentences.zh: 所以从一开始我心中就充满了疑问，这真的太迷人了。

sentences.en: But, you know, for me, I don't even remember how long it was.
sentences.zh: 不过，你知道的，对我来说，我甚至记不清那是多久以前的事了。

sentences.en: I need to look at my CV that I work there full time.
sentences.zh: 我得去看看我的简历，上面写着我在那里全职工作过。

sentences.en: And then I had a car crash leaving the hospital one day.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，我离开医院时遭遇了车祸。

sentences.en: Lucky enough, on the driveway of the hospital, I hit snow and went into a tree.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，在医院的车道上，我打滑撞到了一棵树上。

sentences.en: And on the impact of, you know, hitting the tree, my inner wisdom just said, you have to leave.
sentences.zh: 在撞击的那一刻，你知道的，撞到树的那一刻，我内心的直觉直接告诉我：你必须离开。

sentences.en: And I just intuitively knew that I had to leave that job because I was just I was burning out.
sentences.zh: 我凭直觉就知道我必须辞掉那份工作，因为我当时正在经历职业倦怠。

sentences.en: And I know why I was burning out.
sentences.zh: 我知道我为什么会精疲力竭。

sentences.en: Could you guide us through that a little bit?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们稍微讲讲当时的经历吗？

sentences.en: What that felt like at the time and how that was showing up for you in your work and personal life, if that's OK?
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，当时是什么感觉，这在你的工作和个人生活中又是如何表现出来的？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, like, we've, of course, we had protocols.
sentences.zh: 所以，就像，我们当然有规章制度。

sentences.en: We had ways we were meant to work and everything else.
sentences.zh: 我们有我们必须遵循的工作方式以及其他一切。

sentences.en: And it was definitely around, I think it was around Christmas time, this realisation hit.
sentences.zh: 而且绝对是在那个时候，我想大概是圣诞节左右，我意识到了这一点。

sentences.en: It was definitely snowing, you know.
sentences.zh: 当时确实在下雪，你知道的。

sentences.en: So, and I just noticed that what we just talked about, you know, I was a Buddhist and at the time and I really believed in being present with the young people.
sentences.zh: 所以，我注意到我们刚刚谈到的，我当时是一名佛教徒，我真的坚信要活在当下，陪伴这些年轻人。

sentences.en: And that meant to me just really listening and really being with them.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这意味着真正地倾听并真正地陪伴他们。

sentences.en: And that had the benefit of them just really calming down.
sentences.zh: 这带来的好处是他们真的平静了下来。

sentences.en: Like, these were psychologically ill children.
sentences.zh: 你看，这些都是有心理疾病的孩子。

sentences.en: They were not in a hospital, in a unit for nothing.
sentences.zh: 他们不是无缘无故待在医院病房里的。

sentences.en: They had, you know, severe mental illnesses, you know, psychological mental illnesses.
sentences.zh: 他们患有，你知道的，严重的精神疾病，你知道的，心理精神疾病。

sentences.en: And people acknowledged that I worked differently.
sentences.zh: 大家也承认我的工作方式与众不同。

sentences.en: And in the whole, they were happy with that because I was definitely getting results.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，他们对此很满意，因为我确实取得了成果。

sentences.en: And it was great that I was able to be with the kids at all different times of day.
sentences.zh: 很高兴我能在一天中的不同时间陪伴孩子们。

sentences.en: Sometimes when the psychologist wasn't there.
sentences.zh: 有时是在心理学家不在的时候。

sentences.en: So I seen them at all different times.
sentences.zh: 所以我会在不同的时间见到他们。

sentences.en: Sometimes, but what I knew at the time is that I felt what the children were feeling and I had real empathy with them.
sentences.zh: 有时，但我当时清楚的是，我能感同身受孩子们的情绪，我对他们有真正的同理心。

sentences.en: But to a degree that it didn't seem like my peers had.
sentences.zh: 但这种程度似乎是我的同事们所没有的。

sentences.en: And I could, I either had a really good idea of what they were feeling or I literally felt it physically in my body, what they were feeling.
sentences.zh: 要么我对他们的感受有着很好的把握，要么就是我的身体切切实实地感受到了他们的感受。

sentences.en: And I was, I was 23 or something like that.
sentences.zh: 当时我大概23岁左右。

sentences.en: I was young.
sentences.zh: 我很年轻。

sentences.en: And it was just, it was just too much.
sentences.zh: 而这一切，真的实在是太沉重了。

sentences.en: You know, knowing their trauma and knowing their circumstances and knowing that they'd been abused in all different types of ways.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，了解他们的创伤，了解他们的处境，知道他们曾遭受过各种不同形式的虐待。

sentences.en: And then feeling what they feel and feeling their response to their parents and their parents' response to them.
sentences.zh: 然后去感受他们的感受，感受他们对父母的反应以及他们父母对他们的反应。

sentences.en: And it was just too, too much.
sentences.zh: 这实在是太沉重、太难承受了。

sentences.en: And I'd been somebody that had felt other people's emotions all of my life.
sentences.zh: 我这一生一直都是那种能敏锐感知他人情绪的人。

sentences.en: And I was kind of okay with that.
sentences.zh: 我对此也觉得还能应付。

sentences.en: But in that intense environment, it was hard.
sentences.zh: 但在那种高压的环境下，这就很难了。

sentences.en: And I didn't have the self-given acknowledgement that I'm a highly sensitive person back then.
sentences.zh: 那时候我并没有从内心承认自己是一个高度敏感的人。

sentences.en: It was just the way I'd always been and the way I always was.
sentences.zh: 这只是我一直以来的样子，过去是，现在也是。

sentences.en: And I wouldn't change that.
sentences.zh: 而且我不会改变这一点。

sentences.en: But what I have done, what I have learned is that I'm not always picking up on energy.
sentences.zh: 但我所做到的、我所学到的是，我并不总是去吸收那些能量。

sentences.en: I'm not always picking up on the way somebody feels and what's going on for them internally, you know, and externally.
sentences.zh: 我并不总是去揣摩别人的感受，以及他们内心和外界正在发生的事情，你知道的。

sentences.en: And that has made a huge difference to my life.
sentences.zh: 这给我的生活带来了巨大的改变。

sentences.en: And that's what I bring to a lot of my clients because I work with a lot of sensitive people and empaths.
sentences.zh: 这也是我带给许多客户的理念，因为我接待了很多敏感人群和共情者。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a big job we do, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 是的，我们做的是一份伟大的工作，对吧？

sentences.en: And I think we're more likely to be able to hopefully tune in to others, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，我们更有可能去体察别人的，你知道的，

sentences.en: resonance and their frequency and their emotions and more likely to get it and get why it matters and to be able to kind of piece together some of their story and almost go with it.
sentences.zh: 共鸣、他们的频率以及他们的情绪，我们也更能够理解并明白为什么这很重要，从而能够拼凑出他们的一些故事并几乎与之感同身受。

sentences.en: But that's not without its negatives as well, if you're doing that with all of the people that you're working with, because, you know,
sentences.zh: 但如果你对你共事的每一个人都这样做，这也并非没有负面影响，因为，你知道的，

sentences.en: it's knowing how and when to disconnect from that, that it's not your stuff, that it's someone else's.
sentences.zh: 关键在于知道如何以及何时从中抽离出来，明白这不是你自己的事，而是别人的事。

sentences.en: And the way I do it, I guess, is to think about doing the best possible job I can do at that moment.
sentences.zh: 我想我采取的方法是，专注于在那个当下做到我所能做到的最好工作。

sentences.en: And the bits I've struggled with is when systems or finances mean that I can't do what I deem to be the best for that person.
sentences.zh: 而我感到挣扎的地方在于，当体制或资金限制导致我无法为那个人做出我认为最好的选择时。

sentences.en: So it might be that there's really long waiting lists.
sentences.zh: 所以可能的原因是等待名单真的很长。

sentences.en: And I found that personally really, really difficult.
sentences.zh: 我个人觉得这真的非常非常困难。

sentences.en: So actually, I thought that, yeah, this would be the ideal pathway, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，我曾认为，是的，这会是理想的途径，你知道的，

sentences.en: gold standard in terms of waiting and in terms of what that person needs and what is going to work for them or have a best chance of working for them.
sentences.zh: 在等待时间和那个人所需要的东西方面达到黄金标准，并且这些东西会对他们有效，或者有最大几率对他们有效。

sentences.en: But when I can't do that because of my hands being tied, that's when I find that it leads me further to disillusionment and burnout.
sentences.zh: 但当由于我被绑住了手脚而无法做到这一点时，我发现这会让我进一步陷入幻灭和精疲力竭。

sentences.en: Yeah, I agree with you there about the system.
sentences.zh: 是的，关于体制这一点我非常赞同你的看法。

sentences.en: I'd like to pick up on it.
sentences.zh: 我想接着这个话题继续聊下去。

sentences.en: It's not that I was overthinking it or it's not that I was, you know, taking it home in the way that other people take their work home.
sentences.zh: 并不是说我过度思考了，也不是说像其他人把工作带回家那样把工作情绪带回家。

sentences.en: You know, I'm not saying I didn't do that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我并不是说我完全没这样做过。

sentences.en: There was one occasion where I did.
sentences.zh: 确实有一次我这么做了。

sentences.en: This child is in such a ridiculous situation, in my opinion, and the way that he was being treated.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这个孩子所处的处境极其荒谬，他受到的对待也是如此。

sentences.en: And, you know, and the way the system was built up.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，还有整个体制的构建方式。

sentences.en: And that's the morning I crashed my car.
sentences.zh: 就在那天早上，我出了车祸。

sentences.en: They decided that they couldn't help this child.
sentences.zh: 他们决定无法再帮助这个孩子。

sentences.en: He was going to be put in a locked psychiatric unit.
sentences.zh: 他将被送入封闭式精神病房。

sentences.en: That's what happened back then.
sentences.zh: 过去就是这样的。

sentences.en: And I was, honestly, I was just fumingly angry.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我当时气得发狂。

sentences.en: I was just, I was like, you cannot do this.
sentences.zh: 我当时的状态就是，你们不能这样做。

sentences.en: I'm his key worker.
sentences.zh: 我是他的主要负责工作员。

sentences.en: I know more about this child than everyone else.
sentences.zh: 我对这个孩子的了解比任何人都多。

sentences.en: And for you to go behind my back and do this is like, and they were like, but we're not going behind your back.
sentences.zh: 而你们背着我做出这种决定，这就像是……而他们的反应是：我们没有背着你。

sentences.en: Like this is, this has been scheduled and, and it's not personal.
sentences.zh: 这就像是，这是已经安排好的，而且这不是针对个人。

sentences.en: And I get that it, I get that it wasn't personal, but I had such a relationship with his child.
sentences.zh: 我明白这不针对个人，但我跟这个孩子有着极深的感情。

sentences.en: And I believe that we could really change him.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们真的能够改变他。

sentences.en: But, but they, they had decided amongst the doctors that they was going to go down a different route.
sentences.zh: 但是，但是他们，医生们已经决定要走一条不同的路。

sentences.en: But being, being a highly sensitive person, you, the, the emotions and the empathy are much stronger.
sentences.zh: 但作为，作为一个高度敏感的人，你的情绪和同理心会更强烈。

sentences.en: You feel things much deeper.
sentences.zh: 你对事物的感受会更深。

sentences.en: So, and the difference, a highly sensitive person doesn't feel it in their body.
sentences.zh: 因此不同之处在于，高度敏感的人不会把情绪完全滞留在身体里。

sentences.en: They, they just know what that person's feeling.
sentences.zh: 他们只是能切身感知到那个人的感受。

sentences.en: And then they, they may then feel what they feel about that in their, they will definitely feel what they feel about that in their body.
sentences.zh: 然后他们可能会对这种感受产生他们自己的情绪，他们绝对会在自己的身体里感受到由此带来的情绪。

sentences.en: Um, and it's just a level of sensitivity that, that, that works beautifully in these environments, but it also makes it really difficult unless you can turn it off.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这种敏感度在这些环境中能发挥奇效，但除非你能关闭它，否则也会变得非常困难。

sentences.en: And as, as also as an empath, you know, so, you know, someone would, one of the kids would come in and kick off and, and I would feel what they was feeling.
sentences.zh: 而且，作为一个共情者，你知道的，比如其中一个孩子走进来开始发飙，我就会感受到他们的感受。

sentences.en: I'd feel the rage or the upset or whatever it was.
sentences.zh: 我会感受到那种愤怒、沮丧或无论什么情绪。

sentences.en: Because, and they'd also be part of me and, and this was, I'd be like, I get that.
sentences.zh: 因为，他们也是我的一部分，而当时我会想：我懂。

sentences.en: I get that you're doing that right now.
sentences.zh: 我明白你现在为什么要这么做。

sentences.en: And in fact, I think that's good for you.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我觉得这对你有好处。

sentences.en: Just, just let him carry on.
sentences.zh: 就，就让他继续吧。

sentences.en: Let him do it.
sentences.zh: 让他发泄吧。

sentences.en: There's nothing here that he can harm himself with.
sentences.zh: 这里没有什么东西是他可以用来自残的。

sentences.en: Just, just let him blow it out.
sentences.zh: 就让他把气撒出来吧。

sentences.en: And they'd be like, no, no, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 而他们会说：不，不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: Let's sedate him.
sentences.zh: 给他注射镇静剂吧。

sentences.en: And I'd be like, well, no, you know.
sentences.zh: 而我会说：嗯，不行，你知道的。

sentences.en: And when, when, when I had the authority and I, I could stop that sedation, I did.
sentences.zh: 当，当，当我拥有权力且能够阻止这种镇静剂注射时，我确实阻止了。

sentences.en: And, you know, and most of the time it worked really beautifully.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，大多数时候效果真的非常好。

sentences.en: The kid blew off steam, did what they did.
sentences.zh: 孩子发泄了情绪，做完了他想做的事。

sentences.en: You know, of course, if they was going to hurt themselves or hurt someone else, I would step in.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果他们要伤害自己或伤害别人，我会介入。

sentences.en: I'd literally physically step in.
sentences.zh: 我甚至会直接从物理上去干预。

sentences.en: And I'm quite a small person and most of the adolescents are much bigger than me, but they, they trusted me.
sentences.zh: 我的个子其实很小，而且大多数青少年都比我壮得多，但他们信任我。

sentences.en: And I had a rapport with them that they, I would get them to look in my eyes and they were just instantly calmed down.
sentences.zh: 我和他们建立了一种默契，我能让他们看着我的眼睛，然后他们就会瞬间平静下来。

sentences.en: So that, that was all beautiful, but it, I wasn't allowed to work the way that I saw and I wanted.
sentences.zh: 所以，这一切都很美好，但我却不被允许按照我所看到和想要的方式去工作。

sentences.en: So like you, I, I agree with you.
sentences.zh: 所以就像你一样，我，我同意你的看法。

sentences.en: And, and that, that was difficult.
sentences.zh: 而且，那确实很困难。

sentences.en: And yeah, I was a little arrogant.
sentences.zh: 是的，我当时确实有点傲慢。

sentences.en: And I had all these ideas and I just finished uni and, and everything else.
sentences.zh: 我满脑子都是各种想法，而且刚刚大学毕业，诸如此类。

sentences.en: But I was very passionate and caring about the kids and, and that's what made me burn out.
sentences.zh: 但我对孩子们充满热情和关爱，正是这一点导致了我的精疲力竭。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think, you know, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想，你知道的，绝对是这样的。

sentences.en: If we're not helping people to experience their full range of emotions, which includes the hypo aroused bits, as well as the hypo aroused bits.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不帮助人们体验他们全方位的情绪，这其中既包括高度唤醒的状态，也包括低度唤醒的状态。

sentences.en: We're not necessarily equipping people with the skills to be able to handle it next time.
sentences.zh: 我们就未必能赋予人们下次应对这种情况的技能。

sentences.en: Um, if you, you know, if you're being sedated, then you go from hyper aroused to then, you know, waking up and wondering what's going on, but you've,
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你，你知道的，如果你被注射了镇静剂，那么你就会从高度唤醒状态变成，然后，你知道的，醒来后纳闷发生了什么，但是你，

sentences.en: you've missed that middle bit of, of where you calm down.
sentences.zh: 你错过了中间那段你逐渐平静下来的过程。

sentences.en: Um, and that, I think that is potentially difficult.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这可能是一个难题。

sentences.en: And I think there's an interesting, you know, interesting food for thought there in letting people safely, you know, process and manage their thoughts, feelings and emotions.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这里有一个有趣的，你知道的，值得深思的观点，那就是让人们在安全的情况下，你知道的，去处理和管理他们的思想、感觉和情绪。

sentences.en: Could you tell us a little bit about how you stepped away from your psychology career?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我们聊聊你是如何淡出心理学职业生涯的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, hitting the tree was really a wake up call.
sentences.zh: 是的，撞树那次真的是一个警钟。

sentences.en: Um, so ironically, I had, you know, six weeks ago, because of, because of the, the high emotion and high energy of the job.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以具有讽刺意味的是，就在六周前，因为，因为这份工作的高情绪和高能量。

sentences.en: You know, you know, it, it was a brilliant hospital that I worked in and they were running a new system.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你知道的，我工作的那家医院非常棒，他们当时在运行一套新系统。

sentences.en: That's why I chose this hospital to work in.
sentences.zh: 这就是我选择这家医院工作的原因。

sentences.en: And there was a lot of things that worked really well in it.
sentences.zh: 而且里面有很多运作得很好的事情。

sentences.en: I'd like to say that.
sentences.zh: 我想说明这一点。

sentences.en: And it was a massive education for me being there, working there.
sentences.zh: 在那里工作对我来说是一次巨大的教育。

sentences.en: Um, but just before I hit the tree, six weeks ago, I had taken an active holiday because I knew that I couldn't, like, you know, I needed to do something.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就在我撞树前的六周，我请假去了一趟积极的假期，因为我知道我不能像那样，你知道的，我需要做点什么。

sentences.en: I needed to time out of work.
sentences.zh: 我需要离开工作一段时间。

sentences.en: I needed to do something.
sentences.zh: 我需要做点改变。

sentences.en: So I went on what I thought was a beginner's course in sports massage.
sentences.zh: 所以我去参加了我以为是运动按摩初级课程的培训。

sentences.en: But the lady had put me on an intermediate course because of my qualifications, anatomy and physiology.
sentences.zh: 但那位女士鉴于我的解剖学和生理学资历，把我分到了中级课程。

sentences.en: And then she, she just said, look, if you don't like it, you can go home and you can do the other course because it was a residential course.
sentences.zh: 然后她，她直接说：听着，如果你不喜欢，你可以回家去上另一门课，因为这是一个全封闭培训班。

sentences.en: I was like, okay.
sentences.zh: 我当时想：好吧。

sentences.en: So there I was 10 days and I was a natural and I passed with flying colors.
sentences.zh: 就这样我在那里待了10天，我在这方面很有天赋，并且以优异的成绩通过了考核。

sentences.en: So I was now an unexpectedly qualified, um, sports massage therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在成了一个出乎意料获得资质的，嗯，运动按摩治疗师。

sentences.en: And when I hit the tree and I had various injuries, um, my, I used my own knowledge and got, got most of me better.
sentences.zh: 当我的车撞到树上并受了各种伤时，嗯，我运用自己的知识，让大部分伤情好转了。

sentences.en: You know, I had whiplash.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我得了挥鞭样损伤。

sentences.en: Um, so that's what I treated.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是我治疗的伤情。

sentences.en: What I didn't know is I'd also, um, really severely hurt my left hip, but that didn't, that didn't show up physically until a month later.
sentences.zh: 我当时不知道的是，我的左髋关节也受到了，嗯，非常严重的伤害，但这并没有，直到一个月后才在身体上显现出来。

sentences.en: Um, and so, you know, I started getting treatment for, for my hip a month later and the guy was technically excellent, but his bedside manner was dreadful.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，你知道的，一个月后我开始接受髋关节治疗，那个人技术非常出色，但他的待人接物态度糟糕透顶。

sentences.en: And that was private.
sentences.zh: 而且那是私人的。

sentences.en: It wasn't through the NHS.
sentences.zh: 不是通过国民保健署（NHS）看的。

sentences.en: And I just thought I could do this.
sentences.zh: 而我当时觉得我可以做到这一点。

sentences.en: So I started doing it part time with, with just people around me.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始兼职做这件事，对象就是，身边的那些人。

sentences.en: And, uh, within a year I had enough client base to, to stop my job and, and to do that full time.
sentences.zh: 然后呢，不到一年时间，我就积累了足够的客户群，可以辞掉工作，全职做这个了。

sentences.en: And that's what I did.
sentences.zh: 这就是我当时做的事。

sentences.en: So I just dropped being a psychologist, but ironically, at least 50% of the people that came to me wanted to come to me for mental probleMs.
sentences.zh: 所以我不再当心理学家了，但讽刺的是，来找我的客户中，至少有50%的人是想解决心理问题的。

sentences.en: And I had to keep saying, but I'm no longer a psychologist, you know, let's, you know, is there any physical you want?
sentences.zh: 我不得不一直说，但我已经不再是心理学家了，你知道的，让我们来看看，你知道的，你有什么身体上的需求吗？

sentences.en: And so eventually I just gave in and I, I started treating both.
sentences.zh: 所以最终我妥协了，我，我开始两方面都进行治疗。

sentences.en: And that's how I created my own therapy.
sentences.zh: 这就是我创立自己的疗法的方式。

sentences.en: Lovely.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: Just look at, well, what, what do I love?
sentences.zh: 只要看看，嗯，什么，我到底热爱什么？

sentences.en: What do I spend my time thinking about?
sentences.zh: 我把时间都花在思考什么上面？

sentences.en: You know, when I'm not at work, what, what thoughts go through my head?
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我不在工作时，什么，有什么想法会在我脑海中闪过？

sentences.en: What is it that I really love about my work?
sentences.zh: 我对我的工作真正热爱的是什么？

sentences.en: What is it I love about the studies that I've done?
sentences.zh: 我对所学过的内容热爱的是什么？

sentences.en: What books am I reading?
sentences.zh: 我在读什么书？

sentences.en: What films am I watching?
sentences.zh: 我在看什么电影？

sentences.en: What conversations am I having?
sentences.zh: 我在进行什么样的对话？

sentences.en: And now all of that, I was like, yeah, I really like sports.
sentences.zh: 现在把这些连起来，我就觉得，对，我真的很喜欢运动。

sentences.en: I really thought I'd always done sport.
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得我一直都在做运动。

sentences.en: And I thought, I really, you know, I really like sports.
sentences.zh: 我想，我真的，你知道，我真的很喜欢运动。

sentences.en: So, um, yeah, I would be interested in doing that.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，是的，我会很有兴趣去做这件事。

sentences.en: And I'm still really helping the person.
sentences.zh: 而且我仍然在真正地帮助对方。

sentences.en: There's what I noticed in the psychiatric units was all of the children also had physical probleMs.
sentences.zh: 我在精神科病房注意到的是，所有的孩子也都有身体上的问题。

sentences.en: All of them had, you know, they might have been small, they might have been bigger.
sentences.zh: 他们所有人都有，你知道的，可能很小，也可能更大。

sentences.en: And then, um, yeah, I pretty quickly realized that the majority of people that came to see me for massage, they also had, like, maybe it was stress, maybe it was depression,
sentences.zh: 然后呢，嗯，是的，我很快意识到，大部分来找我做按摩的人，他们也有，比如，可能是压力，可能是抑郁，

sentences.en: or maybe it was something much bigger, like trauma and things like that.
sentences.zh: 或者可能是更严重的问题，比如创伤之类的。

sentences.en: Um, so I became more and more interested in the link between the physical body and the physical problems and the mental problems and the psychological probleMs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我越来越对身体、身体问题与心理问题以及心理学问题之间的联系感兴趣。

sentences.en: And that led me to studying craniosacral therapy, because that brings the two of them together.
sentences.zh: 这引导我开始学习颅骶疗法，因为这把两者结合在了一起。

sentences.en: So, yeah, so to answer your question, in case it's been lost, is to really look at what it is you love and what excites and interests you.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，为了回答你的问题，以防你忘了，就是去真正看看你热爱的是什么，是什么让你兴奋和感兴趣。

sentences.en: And where does that lead you to?
sentences.zh: 而这会把你带向何方？

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And would you say that you are fulfilled and happy and pleased in your sphere of work currently?
sentences.zh: 你会说你目前在你的工作领域中感到充实、快乐和满意吗？

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对是的。

sentences.en: Um, you know, when I start every session with a name, and at the end of the session, you know,
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，当我带着一个名字开始每一次咨询，而在咨询结束时，你知道，

sentences.en: I ask them about that, and I might even poke it a little bit to make sure that it's cleared.
sentences.zh: 我会向他们询问这方面的情况，甚至可能会稍微触及一下，以确保它已经理清了。

sentences.en: And it just amazes me the journey the session goes on.
sentences.zh: 咨询所经历的旅程总是让我惊叹不已。

sentences.en: And then to, to see the person's face when they realise something, and particularly when they let go of it, and I help them let go of even more of it.
sentences.zh: 然后看到当他们意识到某些事情时脸上的表情，特别是当他们放下它的时候，我帮助他们放下更多的时候。

sentences.en: It's just wonderful.
sentences.zh: 简直太美妙了。

sentences.en: I just, I just love it.
sentences.zh: 我真的，我真的很喜欢。

sentences.en: So professional psychology is not the only way to make you happy.
sentences.zh: 所以专业心理学并不是让你快乐的唯一途径。

sentences.en: And that might be a really interesting and useful point for people if they are starting to feel that this is not, it's not for me, it's not making me happy.
sentences.zh: 如果人们开始觉得这不对劲、不适合自己、不能让自己快乐，这可能是一个非常有趣且有用的观点。

sentences.en: You know, I feel like I'm burning out.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得我快要精疲力竭了。

sentences.en: There must be another way.
sentences.zh: 一定还有别的出路。

sentences.en: There might well be, you know, this isn't for everybody.
sentences.zh: 很可能确实有，你知道，这并不适合所有人。

sentences.en: Have you got a take home message for people who might be listening today, Fiona?
sentences.zh: Fiona，对于今天可能在收听节目的听众，你有什么核心寄语吗？

sentences.en: To be who they really are, to ground inside of themselves, to connect to who they really are,
sentences.zh: 去做真实的自己，在内心深处扎根，与真实的自我建立连接，

sentences.en: and to explore that and dare to lift that, dare to be who they really are and show that and be inspired by what they're inspired by, to go with their intuition.
sentences.zh: 去探索这一点，敢于展现它，敢于做真实的自己并将其表现出来，受到内心所受启发的鼓舞，跟随自己的直觉。

sentences.en: Because I don't believe that anybody can work as a psychologist and not intuitively feel something about their clients, their patients, whatever they call them.
sentences.zh: 因为我不相信任何人能作为心理学家工作，而对他们的客户、患者——无论他们怎么称呼——没有直觉上的感受。

sentences.en: And that might not add up when they think about this theory or might not add up to what they are expected to do.
sentences.zh: 这可能在他们思考某种理论时说不通，或者可能不符合他们被期望去做的事情。

sentences.en: But if they feel it inside of themselves and they know it, dare to go with that, dare to go with their own insights and see where that gets their client.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们在内心感受到了并且心知肚明，那就敢于顺应这一点，敢于跟随自己的直觉，看看这能为他们的客户带来什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, I absolutely agree.
sentences.zh: 是的，我完全同意。

sentences.en: You know, you should feel like you're being yourself, like you're being authentic and that you're vibrant in your work.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你应该觉得自己正在做自己，觉得自己是真实且充满活力的。

sentences.en: You know, I think absolutely that's the case.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我绝对认为情况就是这样。

sentences.en: And I believe that about myself and my work currently, for sure.
sentences.zh: 我坚信我自己目前的工作状态就是如此。

sentences.en: Where's the best place for people to connect with you or learn more about you if they want to, Fiona?
sentences.zh: Fiona，如果人们想与你联系或更多地了解你，最好的途径是什么？

sentences.en: On LinkedIn, my name's Fiona Maguire.
sentences.zh: 在领英（LinkedIn）上，我的名字是Fiona Maguire。

sentences.en: Fiona is F-I-O-N-A, and Maguire's M-A-G-U-I-R-E.
sentences.zh: Fiona是F-I-O-N-A，Maguire是M-A-G-U-I-R-E。

sentences.en: And also my website is the same, www.fionamaguire.com, without any spaces.
sentences.zh: 此外，我的网站也是一样的，www.fionamaguire.com，中间没有任何空格。

sentences.en: And I give away, there's free resources, the grounding that I've mentioned,
sentences.zh: 我提供了一些免费资源，比如我提到过的接地气练习，

sentences.en: how to work with your energy, which is a book.
sentences.zh: 如何运用你的能量，这是一本书。

sentences.en: And yeah, people get a lot of benefit out of them.
sentences.zh: 是的，人们从中受益匪浅。

sentences.en: And I'm always happy to chat with somebody on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 我总是很乐意在领英上与大家交流。

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I'll pop all your details in the show notes as well, but not everyone accesses the show notes, so it's always useful to have said that out loud as well.
sentences.zh: 我也会把你的所有详细信息放在节目文稿中，但不是每个人都会看节目文稿，所以把这些大声说出来也总是很有用的。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time today, Fiona, and for helping us answer the question, what happens if you decide psychology is not for you?
sentences.zh: 非常感谢Fiona今天抽出时间，并帮助我们解答“如果你决定心理学不适合你，会发生什么”这个问题。

sentences.en: I know that you still work in the psychology sphere, but professional psychology, because that's a lot of our audience.
sentences.zh: 我知道你仍然在心理学领域工作，但不是专业心理学，因为我们的很多听众都是这样。

sentences.en: So thank you so much for your time and so generously sharing your rich insights with us.
sentences.zh: 所以非常感谢你抽出时间，并如此慷慨地与我们分享你丰富的见解。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Really good to speak with you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能与你交谈。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for my guest, Fiona Maguire, for coming along and talking with us.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢我的嘉宾Fiona Maguire光临并与我们交谈。

sentences.en: I hope you found that to be a useful listen.
sentences.zh: 我希望你觉得这是一次有益的收听。

sentences.en: Like I said, if you want to connect with Fiona, do check the details in my show notes, and that will help put you in touch.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，如果你想联系Fiona，请查看我节目文稿中的详细信息，这会帮助你与她取得联系。

sentences.en: If you are still wanting to pursue professional psychology and you're ready for the next step, then do please check out the Aspiring Psychologist Collective book,
sentences.zh: 如果你仍然想追求专业心理学并且准备好迈出下一步，那么请务必查看《有抱负的心理学家合集》这本书，

sentences.en: the Clinical Psychologist Collective book, and do consider joining the Aspiring Psychologist membership.
sentences.zh: 《临床心理学家合集》这本书，并考虑加入“有抱负的心理学家”会员计划。

sentences.en: We're a really lovely group that are supportive, that helps you towards your goals.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个非常可爱且充满支持的群体，能帮助你实现目标。

sentences.en: And I help you with anything that you think, oh, I'm not worried about that.
sentences.zh: 我会帮你解决任何你觉得“哦，我对此感到担心”的事情。

sentences.en: Then I will find an expert to talk to us about it, to help you, guide you through that process.
sentences.zh: 然后我会找一位专家来和我们谈谈，以帮助你、引导你完成这个过程。

sentences.en: And that's certainly the case with something we've got happening in the membership.
sentences.zh: 我们在会员计划中正在进行的事情绝对就是这样的。

sentences.en: Today, as I record this, we are covering selection tests,
sentences.zh: 在我录制这段音频的今天，我们正在讨论选拔测试，

sentences.en: logical and deductive reasoning tests.
sentences.zh: 逻辑和演绎推理测试。

sentences.en: So if on replay, you're listening to this, you're thinking, oh, I'd like to learn more about that, then you might well find the membership useful for that too.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在回放时听到这里，心想，哦，我想了解更多关于这方面的信息，那么你很可能会发现会员计划对此也很有用。

sentences.en: I would love your reviews, your audio testimonials of the podcast, and of the books too.
sentences.zh: 我非常希望得到你对播客以及书籍的评价和音频反馈。

sentences.en: It's really simple to do that.
sentences.zh: 这做起来非常简单。

sentences.en: If you head to my website, www.goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk forward slash podcast, then just click on the audio testimonial option.
sentences.zh: 如果你访问我的网站 www.goodthinkingpsychology.co.uk/podcast，然后点击音频反馈选项。

sentences.en: And with a few clicks and a couple of minutes, you will have done that.
sentences.zh: 只需点击几下，花上几分钟，你就完成了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Do come and connect with me on socials.
sentences.zh: 快来在社交媒体上与我联系吧。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent in all places that you might hope to find me.
sentences.zh: 在所有你能找到我的地方，我都是 Dr. Marianne Trent。

sentences.en: And yeah, I'm really looking forward to connecting with you and helping you in your journey as an aspiring psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 是的，我非常期待与你联系，并在你成为有抱负的心理学家的旅程中帮助你。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过出售时间之外的方式赚钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是 Dr. Marianne Trent，临床心理学家，我自2019年以来一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One2Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的 One2Many 计划现已开放注册。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年亲自完成了该计划，此后也一直支持两届心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励以及我自己的独家支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次小组大师班、大师课、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 礼品，以及限时的一对一教练奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 注册将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
